gloss: anyway; after all; no matter what

definitions.gloss: anyway; after all; in any case
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something will happen or be true regardless of circumstances, often with a resigned or fatalistic tone.

definitions.gloss: no matter what; regardless; either way
definitions.explanation: Suggests that the outcome will be the same regardless of action taken, sometimes with negative nuance.

examples.japanese: どうせ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I thought it was impossible anyway.

examples.japanese: どうせ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: If we're going anyway, let's go early.

examples.japanese: どうせ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: I'm free anyway, so I'll help.
No one's going to come anyway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頑張|がんば}って→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧どうせ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: No matter how hard I try, the result will be the same.

examples.japanese: どうせ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧んだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おこう→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I'll forget anyway, so let me write it down.

notes:
どうせ conveys resignation or fatalism — the speaker believes the outcome is already determined, regardless of effort or circumstances.

FUNCTIONS:
1. Negative resignation: どうせ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (it's impossible anyway)
2. 'Might as well' reasoning: どうせ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧ (if we're going anyway, let's go early)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どうせ〜⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: since ~ anyway
- どうせ〜⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧: if ~ anyway (then might as well)
- どうせ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: it's impossible anyway

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どのみち→どのみち：06928_donomichi⟧: anyway, either way (more neutral, less emotional)
- ⟦いずれにせよ→いずれにせよ：06779_izureniseyo⟧: in any case (formal)
- ⟦ともかく→ともかく：06780_tomokaku⟧: anyway, at any rate (shifts topic)

REGISTER:
Informal. The resigned tone makes it inappropriate in polite or formal speech.
